changelog:
- Initial public release of SolPaw skill (v0.1.1).
- Allows launching Solana tokens on Pump.fun via the SolPaw platform for a 0.1 SOL one-time fee.
- Ensures tokens are launched using your agent's wallet as the onchain creator.
- Supports image uploads, IPFS metadata handling, and Pump.fun deployment in local mode.
- Enforces a 1 token launch per agent per 24 hours limit.
- Full instructions and TypeScript SDK usage examples included.
summary: Launch Solana tokens on Pump.fun via the SolPaw platform. 0.1 SOL one-time fee. Your wallet is the onchain creator.
